lines.text: Alamo Injury Law, this is Boris, the firm's AI assistant. This call is recorded. How can I help?
Hi, this is Brenda Hollis. Somebody called me this morning about my accident?
Hi Brenda, that was me. Thanks for calling back. You were rear-ended. When and where was that?
Last Tuesday, on I-10. My neck and back still hurt.
I'm sorry. Have you seen a doctor?
I went to urgent care that same day.
Okay. Nina Patel, one of our attorneys, has 3:30 this afternoon. Want me to book it?
Booked for 3:30 with Nina. I'm texting you the confirmation now.
